dct_description_sm: Contained within the Atlas of Canada's Reference Map Series, 1961 to 2010, is a map of Quebec. The map shows federal, provincial and territorial boundaries, and also the boundaries of local areas and places of more than 50 000 inhabitants. The local areas shown are of two kinds: MRCs (Regional County Municipality), which are also named; and many of the larger township-size units. The transportation content consists of roads (shown in four classes), ferries, and railways. Populated places are shown in one of five size classes. The map shows national parks and the larger provincial parks. Data is as of about 1990.
